heard: The space station is wider than a football field. It weighs over 900,000 pounds across 356 feet of solar arrays. More than 40 delivery flights assembled this giant 250 miles above Earth. Yet inside, its entire pressurized living space equals just one Boeing 747. Seven astronauts orbit the planet inside it at five miles per second. That speed carries them around the entire globe every 90 minutes. NASA plans to crash this 400-ton Titan into the Pacific Ocean around 2030. It is a dramatic end for an outpost wider than a football field.
